lesson.title: Multiplying Powers with the Same Base
intro: When multiplying powers with the **same base**, add the exponents.
This rule works because multiplying powers combines repeated multiplication.
Always make sure the bases are the same before adding exponents.

workedExample.aiHint: When multiplying powers with the same base, add the exponents.

questions.explanation: Multiply coefficients: 2 × 5 = 10 and add exponents: \(a^{3+4} = a^7\).

questions.prompt: Which expression is equivalent to \(x^5 \cdot x^3\)?
questions.explanation: Add exponents when multiplying powers with the same base: \(x^{5+3} = x^8\).
